# R7.6 — P4-C confirmation fold + §8.8 claims packet (manifest 333)

Disposition: **done — executed, offline (USD $0.00)**. The fold reads the
committed terminal window record and emits one deterministic packet; no
window, spend or publication act is in scope.

- Gate envelope: GATE-G36 / G-P4-C `PASSED — run` (2026-11-24T21:10Z) +
  the 2026-11-25 resume-with-repair amendment; the fold is the
  records-side close-out of that authorized window.
- Inputs (all committed, all pinned in `scripts/fp-p4c-fold-inputs.txt`):
  prereg `hh-p4-c-prereg/1` `1d55d48a…`, selection packet
  `9c3c314c…` `selected{m=1}` → V1, and the terminal window record
  `hh-fp-window/1` `2026-11-26-fp-p4c-window-r4.json` (370/370 recorded,
  0 withheld — embeds every slot's `reward_file`, so no separate
  slot-matrix extract exists or is needed).
- Requirement IDs: primary REQ-XD-215 (baseline re-run — the window's
  baseline arm is fresh, no phase-2/X1 reuse), REQ-XD-216 (Holm α = .05,
  unavailable members retained), REQ-XD-219 (typed dispositions);
  contributing REQ-XD-222 (§8.8 claims surface), REQ-XD-224
  (selection-labelled exploratory estimates), REQ-XD-213 (descriptive
  cost, never inferential).

## Machinery (this branch)

- `crates/hh-runner/src/fp_p4c_fold.rs` — the fold: parses the
  terminal `hh-fp-window/1` record, builds `PlannedPopulation` +
  `SlotSubject`s, and runs `comparative_estimand`,
  `confirmatory_family` (Holm + two-sided sharp-null sign-flip under
  `slot_schedule_randomization`, `use_as=confirmatory` gated by
  `g23_admission()`), and the finite-manifest-rate/contrast paths.
  Exchangeability evidence is reconstructed from `schedule_rows` into a
  `RandomizationRecord` (`kind=k_round_interleave`,
  `seed=p4-c-schedule-r7.4-2026-11-24`, rounds=5) whose
  `ScheduleEvidence::check` passes inside `confirmatory_family`.
- `crates/hh-runner/src/bin/p4c_fold.rs` — thin deterministic emitter
  (the `p4_fold` pattern); reads the inputs manifest, writes the
  packet + bare-hex `.sha256` sidecar (`shasum -a 256 -c` form).
- `docs/build/reports/2026-11-26-fp-p4c-confirmation.json` —
  committed `hh-p4-c-confirmation/1` packet, sha256
  `ebaf0b17f7c3ae22b1be39f2c646a17c58b4c4e23b7b233c3ede9c754752f44c`.
- `crates/hh-runner/tests/r7_6.rs` — 7-test acceptance battery
  (AC-1 recompute byte-identical + Holm-retains-unavailable + sidecar;
  AC-2 banned equality/equivalence wording refused, `withheld{…}`
  typed, unexecuted ≠ null; AC-3 §8.8 claims-surface lexicon over the
  packet corpus).
- `scripts/check-fp-p4c.sh` — 5-leg checker (scratch re-emit
  byte-identical, sidecar `shasum -c`, packet-shape asserts, claims
  lexicon, acceptance battery).
- `crates/hh-runner/src/bin/p4_admissibility.rs` — one-character
  pre-existing lint repair (`+` → `\+` doc escape,
  `doc_lazy_continuation`); doc text only, no emitted bytes move.

## Outcome (what the fold found)

- Population: 367/370 slots resolved. Three unresolved —
  `p4c-baseline-headless-terminal-r2` and
  `p4c-baseline-kv-store-grpc-r5` (`verifier_unavailable{verifier_timeout}`),
  `p4c-V1-model-extraction-relu-logits-r4` (verifier rc 125 podman
  name collision, no `reward_file`). Unresolved members are never
  imputed.
- Primary estimand, V1 vs baseline Δ̂: `refused{UnresolvedCell…}` —
  three tasks carry an unresolved cell on one arm, so the pairing
  refuses honestly rather than pairing what is absent. The
  `paired_cell_all_planned_bound` publishes `bound_ppm`
  [-10810, 5406]; the labelled **conditional secondary** task-bootstrap
  interval over the 34 eligible tasks publishes [-76470, 58824] —
  never promoted to a confirmatory claim.
- Holm family P4-C1: 1 member (the V1 contrast), unavailable mass
  retained at worst case per REQ-XD-216;
  `adjusted_p_ppm = 1000000`, `rejected_at_alpha = false`.
- V1 disposition: `inconclusive{unresolved_cell}` — the REQ-XD-219
  "not confirmed; interval includes 0 / inconclusive" template family;
  never equality or equivalence wording, `withheld{…}` stays typed,
  unexecuted members are never null.
- `packet_disposition`: `executed — no selected member was confirmed
  different from the baseline at Holm α = .05 on 37 held-out tasks`.
- §8.8 claims surface: `statement_confirmatory` in the "Not confirmed…"
  form; `statement_exploratory` in the exploratory-ranking form with
  the expected-optimism label; mandatory labels verbatim including
  `w_window: not_applicable{no_compaction_members}`; cost rows
  descriptive-only (baseline 10,398,498 µ$ / V1 6,239,536 µ$ model
  per-slot totals — REQ-XD-213).
- Terminal-state record for CAP7.1: `earlier_attempts` carries w1
  `stop{budget}` + the 222 withheld slots and w2 `native_lane_hold`
  verbatim; `unexecuted` stays typed `not_executed{…}`, never null.
